blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The country’s farm production dropped by 5 percent to P389.42 billion in the third quarter of this year, weighed down by crops and fisheries, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA). The statistics agency said in a report on Thursday that crop production, which accounts for more than half of the overall agriculture and fisheries production, decreased by 9.3 percent to P197.71 billion. READ: Habagat, El Niño may hit farm output despite ample supply Palay (unmilled rice) and corn, the primary drivers of crop output, posted double-digit declines of 17.8 percent and 17.4 percent, respectively.
